items.name: ArchiveBox
items.source_story_title: If you love a website, back it up
items.summary: Self-hosted searchable web archive; long-term users praise it but flag maintenance overhead.

evidence_sources.author: drpfenderson
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you're making archiving a more involved part of your workflow, I highly recommend ArchiveBox. It can save pretty much every type of file from everywhere, in almost every format you can imagine, while building a searchable index of the archives. Been using it successfully for many years:

evidence_sources.author: flippant
evidence_sources.excerpt: I used ArchiveBox for years. It's really good. The self-hosting and maintenance gets annoying after a while though.

items.name: SingleFile
items.source_story_title: If you love a website, back it up

items.evidence: revolvingthrow praises SingleFile's single-page captures and simple output, reporting success on over 90% of webpages. FireInsight recommends using SingleFile with Linkding for bookmarking and archiving.

evidence_sources.author: revolvingthrow
evidence_sources.excerpt: SingleFile is great for single pages. All the tweaking I do is enable or disable saving scripts, and it works for >90% of webpages. Output being a single file (heh) simplifies things enormously

evidence_sources.author: FireInsight
evidence_sources.excerpt: I'm using Linkding hooked up with SingleFile to bookmark+archive all important pages. Highly recommend!
